verdict.rationale: Vanta's docs confirm it tracks "monitored computers" and personnel in scope for audits (vanta-docs-29). Its API supports evidence collection and testing for Mobile Device Managers (vanta-docs-32), so per-device workstation monitoring through an MDM path is evidenced. Nothing in the pack names the specific checks the story asks for or a Vanta endpoint agent. missing for 10: documented disk-encryption, screen-lock and password-manager checks, a first-party device agent, explicit per-employee workstation compliance views, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
